steps.headline: 3. Right-click the microphone to open Vocabulary.
steps.changed: The editor moves to the microphone. The separate Settings card is gone.
steps.notice: A normal click still starts or stops dictation.
steps.risk: Right-click is less discoverable than a Settings entry.

steps.headline: 4. Each word or phrase is a removable chip.
steps.changed: Add a phrase with the field; remove it with its chip’s ×.
steps.notice: No multiline text box. Save applies the edited list.

steps.headline: Try adding and removing vocabulary chips.
steps.changed: Right-click the mic, choose Vocabulary, add a phrase, remove a chip, then Save.
steps.notice: Check whether this is the editing style you wanted.
steps.risk: Practice data only; saving does not change recordings.
